sentences.japanese: 彼女は労を惜しまず空港へ友人を迎えに行った。
sentences.english: She took the trouble to meet her friend at the airport.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は彼らのために労をいとわず家を見つけてやった。
sentences.english: She took the trouble to find a home for them.

sentences.japanese: 彼は労をいとわず私を助けてくれた。
sentences.english: He spared no pains to help me.
